identification: Avon 1876 Cape Cod pattern ruby red pressed glass (Avon Products, USA, produced from 1975 to about 2000s): about 7 footed mugs, 2 tall vases, 2 stacks of plates (roughly 6 large dinner/dessert plates and 8 smaller plates), about 14 saucers, 4 bowls, 4 hexagonal candle holders. Two boxes. Mass-produced collectable, widely available.
